DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Angle-Closure Glaucoma.

Given your age, the subacute progression of headache, and worsening vision without fever or weight loss, the clinical picture strongly suggests acute or subacute angle-closure glaucoma. I am requesting an immediate slit-lamp exam with gonioscopy and intraocular pressure measurement to confirm this.
